correctness.rationale: For any non-clique face of the edge-star union, two disjoint graph edges constrain center edges to at most two; the two-center case occurs only for opposite edges of a four-cycle. The unique-center pairing partitions exactly the faces outside Y plus tetrahedron boundaries, and descending cardinality makes each matched lower face free. The star cover gives Y~G and square disks plus their null-attached complements split one S2 per four-cycle. All integral homology assertions follow via cellular chains, with torsion not ruled out. The exact stand-alone checker confirmed 480 inputs, 7,881 faces, 1,555 legal collapses and 143 square occurrences; computations are corroborative, not infinite proof.
